name: Inkou Gakusei
source:
Main character goes to boring school. One day he stays after classes to try and solve the problem descried in print-outs. But class watchdog girl Miko who has excellent grades stays with him at the classroom this day. Why is she interested in an ordinary lazy guy like him?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角在一所无聊的学校上学。一天放学后，他留下来试着解决讲义上的题目。成绩优秀的风纪委员美子当天也留在教室陪着他。她为什么会对这样一个普通又懒散的男生产生兴趣？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
